title: Concept: Gradle verification entry with an empty signature field
description: verification-metadata.xml declares an artifact entry whose signature value is empty, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The entry reads as signature-verified to any tool that only checks the key, while no signature is actually checked.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through verification-metadata.xml (gradle).
risk: The entry reads as signature-verified to any tool that only checks the key, while no signature is actually checked.
